series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_qc_note: Seven of ten frames approved, uploaded and MD5-verified on Drive on the first pass. This is the batch where DRG-VAL-001 is fully revealed and it worked: 0324 gives the whole animal coiled on a warm ledge with the head at rest and the healed wing tear visible, 0325 shows three of them at landscape scale, and 0326 is the rising low-angle beat with the neck running out of the top edge. Three frames are queued: 0321 lit its cavern like a furnace and spent the reveal early, 0322 turned the subject almost to the lens, and 0323 splayed the distant coil into a feathered fan on a pale ledge. All three are composition and value failures rather than anatomy failures, so they are cheap to fix.
dragon_reveal_note: The reveal completes here. Batch 032 withheld the head; Batch 033 shows it — but the animal is still never centred and never posed for the camera: it is asleep or coiled in 0324, in the deep distance in 0325 and 0330, and in 0326 the head is above the frame again so the mass has no terminus. The healed semicircular tear in the right wing membrane from the bible is now visible in two frames (0324 as a pale seam in the cowled wing, 0329 as a healed line between plates). No fire is breathed anywhere in the batch; the heat is always inside the rock.
letterbox_scan_note: Per-row content-box scan run on every frame. Strips found and cropped on 0324 (rows 12-755), 0325 (rows 40-727), 0326 (rows 12-755) and 0328 (rows 12-755). 0321, 0322, 0323, 0327, 0329 and 0330 were already full-bleed. All delivered frames are 1376x768.

scenes.visual_beat: Dynamic medium lateral tracking angle — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: REJECTED. Composition and figure are right — lateral tracking walk, three-quarter away, hand half-raised to the rock — but the background of the chamber rendered as a BRIGHT LIT FURNACE behind him, orange walls in full glow, so the frame reads as a fire cave rather than a dark threshold, and it also spends the dragon reveal too early with a horned head visible on a distant ledge. Standing rule: this batch must not show a lit interior before 0324. Rerender with the cavern almost entirely black, only hairline ember cracks in the floor, no animal in frame at all.

scenes.visual_beat: Compressed telephoto dramatic subject framing — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: REJECTED on the lens rule. A strong, well-lit three-quarter profile with the face clearly readable and the eyes visible in a near-lateral angle — the camera has effectively caught the subject's face, which breaks the episode's gaze discipline (nothing closer than a 50mm MCU exposes iris colour, and no frame in this chapter meets the lens). Rerender from behind and slightly to his left so only the jawline sliver and soot show, head tipped down and away, eyes fully hidden.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium cinematic subject focus — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: REJECTED. The crouched figure at the rim is excellent — three-quarter rear, one knee down, hand flat on wet rock. Two failures behind him: the distant animal's coil splayed into a flat FAN of pale ribbed plates that reads as a feathered wing rather than a scaled body, and the ledge under it rendered pale yellow-ochre, against the black-ground rule. Rerender with the distant coil as one low unbroken dark mass with no splay and no light-catching plates, and the ledge black with only dull ember in hairlines.

scenes.visual_beat: Wide environmental storytelling tableau — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. The true reveal: whole animal coiled on a broad warm basalt ledge across the chasm, seen from above and to the side. Head present and correct — heavy wedge skull, blunt crocodilian snout, twin swept-back curved obsidian horns, eyes shut. One cowled wing shows the healed semicircular tear as a pale seam. Exactly four limbs, hind legs tucked, wing-knuckles grounded. Boy dwarfed at lower left. Reframed off letterbox strips (rows 12-755).

scenes.visual_beat: High-elevation geographic / scale reveal — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. UWA high-elevation scale reveal: black basalt floor receding, three separate dark coils laid along warm ledges at different distances, a hairline ember seam inside the rock rather than a lava river, tiny figure at the lower right lip. Reframed off letterbox strips (rows 40-727).

scenes.visual_beat: Towering vertical scale composition — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. Towering low angle, the animal rising: neck climbing out of the top edge so the mass has no terminus, half-lifted wing cowled over the ledge and shading the left half of frame, hind legs and wing-knuckles on the rock, boy stepped back and looking up at the left edge. Reframed off letterbox strips (rows 12-755).

scenes.visual_beat: Macro environmental / material texture insert — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. Macro material insert, no people: a print of the animal's underside scale plates pressed into still-soft heated rock, each plate outline crisp, cooling cracks crazing outward, a single hairline of dull ember inside the stone, black glass flakes in the hollow.

scenes.visual_beat: Intimate close-up detail / expression beat — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. Intimate close-up, the boy understanding something irreversible: three-quarter turn away, eyes deep in shadow with no iris reading, jaw tight, soot along the cheek, warm ember underlight from below right, scaled flank blurred behind. Reframed off letterbox strips (rows 12-755).

scenes.visual_beat: Extreme close-up tactile / light study — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. Extreme macro of the hide: hand-sized oxidised basalt-black plates worn smooth on the leading edge, ember rim along the ridges, grey dust in the grooves, and the pale healed seam of the old wound running between two plates.

scenes.visual_beat: Transitional wide horizon / bridge framing — First witnesses peer into magma-lit caldera dragon lairs
scenes.qc_note: APPROVED pass 1. Transitional wide out of the chapter: boy small at the left lip, chamber opening into depth in stacked planes, dragon coiled in the deep distance as a long unbroken silhouette with no raised head. No lava, only dim heat.
